title: Memory Palace OS V0.6 equal-compute-budget architecture experiment

protocol.budgetDefinition: Equal reserved deterministic compute units: one architecture-search unit per candidate plus the full per-case inference budget reserved for each training case. Inference uses an identical per-episode cap; actual consumed units are reported separately.
limitations: Synthetic learner and labelled-cause simulator only; not human memory evidence.
Search budget units are deterministic accounting units, not CPU seconds or energy.
The untuned reference is reported for context and is not part of the equal-search-budget comparison.
